relatedmaterial.head: Related Material
relatedmaterial.p: The holdings of the Special Collections Library include several other collections that researchers interested in ADI/ASIS/ASIS&T should consult, including the Cloyd Dake Gull Papers and the National Microfilm Association Records.

separatedmaterial.head: Separated Material
separatedmaterial.p: Most printed materials have been removed and cataloged separately.

bioghist.p: The American Society for Information Science is a non-profit professional association that creates, organizes, disseminates and applies knowledge regarding information and its transfer.

scopecontent.p: The records consist of correspondence, business and financial documents, minutes, bylaws, and memoranda covering the society's activities from 1925 to 2001.
